limitations: Three repeats per model and input protocol; not evidence of a reliable gain.

All formatter implementations passed the feature checks. Two base candidates failed the clean package requirement because they included disallowed fixture files; do not describe these as coding failures.
Fresh scale-zero controls share the loaded adapter memory, runtime, quantization and task settings. Historical scores remain separate.

Advisory app protocol qualification failed for the base and passed after repairs for the adapter; neither demonstrated first-pass qualification. Admission was the frozen benchmark plus ordinary-task rule.
Ordinary-task families overlap training/validation and are regression checks, not held-out capability tests.
The 18 historical Unicode validation examples are a narrow checkpoint-selection set, not an independent final benchmark.
One supplied hashing parent and one familiar prescribed formatter extension; no autonomous first-upgrade or broad self-improvement credit.
Visible and withheld final input protocols include different instructions and must be reported separately.
Training used NF4 and official instruction Qwen/Qwen3.5-9B; inference used published Q6_K with an F32 LoRA. GGUF upstream ancestry metadata does not prove an identical original HF checkpoint.
Logical input-token sums include cached prefixes and are not uncached compute or financial cost.
Per-trial trace/tokens/timing completeness does not include deployment warmup and qualification overhead. Total elapsed time includes those stages.
No permanent app activation, seed edits, full model merge, commit or push was performed.
